classification.difficultyReason: The same task as p22-q6: curved or end area as a percentage of total surface area, rounded to 2 d.p. Part b only swaps which component is the numerator.

content.prompt: Give your answers to 2 decimal places.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express the curved surface area of this cylinder as a percentage of the total surface area.

answer.worked:
Curved surface:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{curved}}&=2\pi rh\\A_{\text{curved}}&=2\pi(3.5)(12)\\A_{\text{curved}}&=84\pi\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
Total surface:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi(3.5)^2+2\pi(3.5)(12)\\A_{\text{total}}&=108.5\pi\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage}&=\frac{84\pi}{108.5\pi}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage}&\approx77.42\%\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Express the area of the two circular ends of this cylinder as a percentage of the total surface area.

answer.worked:
Two circular ends:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{ends}}&=2\pi r^2\\A_{\text{ends}}&=2\pi(6)^2\\A_{\text{ends}}&=72\pi\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Total surface:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi(6)^2+2\pi(6)(2.5)\\A_{\text{total}}&=102\pi\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage}&=\frac{72\pi}{102\pi}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage}&\approx70.59\%\end{align*}$$
